about: The soft triblock-copolymer gel of Fakhouri, Hutchens and Crosby (2015, Soft Matter 11, 4723), punctured by sphere-tipped needles, with the constants as Fregonese and Bacca (2021, J. Mech. Phys. Solids, doi:10.1016/j.jmps.2021.104497; arXiv 2412.09809, p. 9) state them. Every value is labelled by its source; a value marked placeholder is not a measurement.

labels.young_modulus: derived: 2 mu (1 + nu) with mu = 7.2 kPa (read: Fregonese and Bacca, p. 9, from Fakhouri et al.) and the placeholder nu
labels.poisson_ratio: placeholder: the gel is nearly incompressible; 0.45 (kappa about 9.7 mu) is chosen for the solver's conditioning, not measured
labels.toughness: read: Fregonese and Bacca, p. 9: Gc = 25 J/m^2 for Fakhouri et al.'s gel
labels.length_scale: placeholder: the AT2 length scale is not a property the source states; it sets the model's strength (about sqrt(E Gc / l)), so it is a declared choice to be tested, not a value
labels.stretch_limit: placeholder (read only by the element-deletion control)
labels.residual_stiffness: numerical: the fully damaged material's share of stiffness

model: compressible neo-Hookean (no stiffening term: Fregonese and Bacca's theory needs Ogden alpha = 9 to meet these data below mu R / Gc of about 0.3) with an AT2 phase field
